Name: Legacy Cellar
Author: ItsLunatyx
Description:
[center][img]https://imgtr.ee/images/2024/03/30/f8e289e934fd2a4bd463cc51f55f855d.png[/img][/center]

[font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][center]Here is a larger, more spacious cellar for your house! Includes a large main floor, and then an additional lower level,
for indoor planting! If you prefer, there is also two optional versions available without the planting area, (with or without the decorations) and instead have two large rooms as seen in the pictures, for you to use and decorate however you'd like![/center][center][img]https://imgtr.ee/images/2024/03/30/e2f64d35e60250d046548bf09687a839.png[/img][/center][center][youtube]jawZvSIaw0w[/youtube][/center][center]﻿[/center]
I thought I'd put together a video to show the mods I've created so far for Stardew Valley, so you can see them in game! All are fully compatible with the latest 1.6 update! Time stamps and links are below for your convenience so you can skip to any particular mod you want to see. Thank you for all the amazing comments and feedback on Nexus so far, I appreciate it so, so much. I hope you continue to have fun with these and enjoy them as much as I am!  PS I realised I forgot to show the vineyard in Legacy Farm but I'll make sure to next time! There are pictures on Nexus <3
